description: This file defines the MemoryStore class and related classes/traits for in-memory block storage management in Apache Spark, including serialization, deserialization, memory eviction, and unrolling logic.

classes.name: MemoryStore
classes.description: Manages in-memory storage of blocks, including adding, evicting, and retrieving blocks, with support for serialization and unrolling.

classes.name: MemoryEntry
classes.description: Trait representing a memory block entry, with size, memory mode, and class tag.

classes.name: DeserializedMemoryEntry
classes.description: Memory entry storing deserialized Java object array.

classes.name: BlockEvictionHandler
classes.description: Trait for handling block eviction from memory, possibly spilling to disk.

classes.name: PartiallyUnrolledIterator
classes.description: Iterator over partially unrolled/deserialized block data, with resource cleanup.

classes.name: PartiallySerializedBlock
classes.description: Represents a block that was only partially serialized, with methods to complete or discard.

classes.name: SerializedValuesHolder
classes.description: Holds serialized values during unrolling before storing.

classes.name: DeserializedValuesHolder
classes.description: Holds deserialized values during unrolling before storing.

classes.name: MemoryEntryBuilder
classes.description: Builds a MemoryEntry from stored values.

classes.name: ValuesHolder
classes.description: Interface for holding values during unrolling, supporting storage and size estimation.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns size of a block in memory.

methods.name: putBytes
methods.description: Stores a block as bytes if enough memory is available.

methods.name: putIterator
methods.description: Unrolls an iterator into memory, possibly evicting other blocks.

methods.name: putIteratorAsValues
methods.description: Unrolls an iterator into deserialized values, with partial fallback.

methods.name: putIteratorAsBytes
methods.description: Unrolls an iterator into serialized bytes, with partial fallback.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves serialized bytes of a block.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves deserialized values of a block.

methods.name: freeMemoryEntry
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a memory entry.

methods.name: evictBlocksToFreeSpace
methods.description: Evicts blocks to free up specified space.

methods.name: reserveUnrollMemoryForThisTask
methods.description: Reserves memory for unrolling a block for the current task.

methods.name: releaseUnrollMemoryForThisTask
methods.description: Releases unroll memory for the current task.

methods.name: currentUnrollMemory
methods.description: Returns total unroll memory used across all tasks.

methods.name: currentUnrollMemoryForThisTask
methods.description: Returns unroll memory used by the current task.
